description: The SDM Smart Line Chart is a professional-grade Power BI custom visual that goes beyond the built-in line chart with advanced features for trend analysis and time series visualization. Key features: Multiple curve types: monotone (smooth), linear, step-before, step-after — choose the interpolation that best represents your data End-of-line labels with staircase channels: label each series directly at the end of its line, with automatic staircase positioning to avoid overlaps Data-driven series colors: assign hex color codes to each series via a DAX measure for consistent, automated coloring Series logos: display base64-encoded brand images in the legend for instant recognition Customizable markers: circle, square, diamond, triangle, cross — with per-series color matching and size control Smart data labels: intelligent placement with overlap prevention, optional series-colored text and backgrounds Analytics overlays: min, max, median, average reference lines with shade area bands between them Oblique axis labels: automatic rotation when horizontal space is limited Full formatting control: line width, dash styles, legend positioning, tooltip configuration The visual supports cross-filtering, tooltips, and is built for enterprise dashboards where readability, branding, and trend clarity are essential. Documentation: https://socio-data-management.github.io/sdmpbigraph-docs/
